# Landly Server — Copilot instructions

Condensed rules for reviewing and writing code here. `AGENTS.md` in the repo root is the
authoritative long form (RBAC table, domain rules, env vars, docker, tooling) — when in
doubt, follow it; when you change a convention, update both files.

## Architecture

Rust (edition 2024) / Actix Web, layered per feature:

```
HTTP → Authentication middleware → Controller → Usecase → Repository → Diesel/DB
                                                        ↓
                                            Cache (Redis or NoOp) · Storage (S3/R2 or NoOp)
```

Current features: `common`, `corridor`, `country_connection`, `healthcheck`, `images`,
`moderation`, `organisation`, `person`, `report`, `review`, `saved`, `user`.

Each `src/app/features/<feature>/` has `config.rs` (routes), `controllers.rs` (thin,
utoipa-annotated), `requests.rs` (DTOs), `usecases.rs` (validation + RBAC), `repositories.rs`
(trait + impl + `*RepositoryInput`), `presenters.rs` (`*Content` → `HttpResponse`),
`entities.rs` (domain types, enums, Diesel models and their SQL methods), `mod.rs` (+ the
feature's `ApiDoc`). Exceptions: `healthcheck` (controllers + mod only), `common` (older
layout). Reference implementations: `corridor/` (smallest), `organisation/` (fullest).
All concrete types are wired in `DiContainer` (`src/utils/di.rs`).

## Rules a change must not break

**Auth & identity**
- Auth is opt-in: only routes in `AUTH_REQUIRED_ROUTES` (`middlewares/auth.rs`) are checked.
  Every POST/PUT/DELETE goes there unless the request carries its own credential — those are
  listed with a reason in `INTENTIONALLY_PUBLIC_MUTATING_ROUTES` (auth.rs tests). Never add
  `/api/person/claim/*`. `SKIP_AUTH_ROUTES` is not consulted.
- Patterns use `{id}` segments (`path_matches`), never bare `starts_with`.
- The caller id comes only from `req.extensions()` (`caller_user_id`), never from the body.
- Role/ownership checks live in usecases (`ensure_can_manage`, `ensure_admin`,
  `ensure_moderator`, `fetch_user_role` → `UserRole::is_moderator/is_admin`) and run before
  any write or side effect.

**Data & errors**
- New orgs/people start `pending`; list/search return only public rows; a creator editing a
  `live` org sends it back to `pending`. Person contacts only via `PersonContent::from_gated`.
- No SQL enums: `TEXT` + `CHECK`, Rust enum with `as_str()` / `TryFrom<&str>` validated in the
  usecase (unknown value → 422).
- `AppError` maps constraint violations to 422 with a generic message + constraint name; no
  Postgres messages or library error strings reach clients. Signin answers the same 401 for
  unknown email and wrong password.
- Never put a JWT in a URL. Google OAuth: state cookie, verified email, single-use login code
  exchanged via `POST /api/user/oauth/google/exchange`; needs Redis.

**Infrastructure**
- Cache keys only through `CacheKeys` (disjoint namespaces); repositories invalidate their
  pattern on every write.
- Rate limiters are built once in `main` and cloned into workers (credential routes get
  `auth_rate_limit()`).
- `src/data/schema.rs` is generated by `diesel migration run` — never edit it; never rewrite an
  applied migration, add a new one with a full `down.sql`.
- docker-compose secrets via `${VAR:?}` only, read in shell snippets as `"$$VAR"`.
- After changing structs used by `scripts/crates` (`Country`, `CreateCountry`), build that
  separate workspace too.

## OpenAPI

Every route has `#[utoipa::path]` (path without `/api`, `context_path = "/api"`) and is listed
in its feature `ApiDoc` (`paths(...)` + `schemas(...)`), which `build_openapi()` in `main.rs`
merges. Never add paths to the root `#[openapi]`. Docs UI: `/scalar`; spec:
`/api-docs/openapi.json`.

## Tests & CI

- Tests are inline `#[cfg(test)]` and need no database: usecases against hand-written stub
  repositories (`review/usecases.rs`), asserting that rejected calls never reach the repository.
- Guard tests fail when a route is missing from `ApiDoc` or the spec has a stale path (`main.rs`),
  or when a mutating route is unprotected / an `AUTH_REQUIRED_ROUTES` entry matches no route
  (`auth.rs`). Fix the code, don't loosen the test.
- CI: `cargo fmt -- --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings`,
  `cargo test`, scripts-workspace build, `cargo audit` (ignores with reasons in
  `.cargo/audit.toml`). End-to-end: `scripts/smoke.sh` against a running stack.
